title: Framework metadata
description: The YAML frontmatter of one knowledge/frameworks/<id>.md file. scripts/frameworks/build-index.py enforces the required fields and copies exactly these fields into framework-index.yaml; the Markdown body below the frontmatter is never indexed and is opened only by steps the router selected it for.

id.description: Kebab-case; must equal the file name without .md.

name.description: Human name, e.g. Porter's Five Forces.

purpose.description: One sentence: what analytical question the framework answers.

problemTypes.description: Analytical problem types this framework serves. Their union across the registry is the classifier's vocabulary and the router's retrieval key. Reuse an existing type before coining a new one.

doNotUseWhen.description: Hard exclusions: a sub-problem matching one of these rejects the framework before scoring.

questionsAnswered.description: The questions a completed analysis answers; used to score questionCoverage.

requiredEvidence.description: Kinds of evidence the analysis needs; the research plan turns these into data requirements.

complexity.description: Effort and evidence burden: 1 = a 2x2 you can fill from a few facts, 5 = a multi-part model needing many data points. Drives the unnecessaryComplexity penalty.

overlapsWith.description: Framework ids that answer largely the same questions; drives the frameworkOverlap penalty.

pairsWellWith.description: Framework ids that complement it on the same branch.
